commits.subject: design-system(tokens): bridge theme.borderRadius to the control radius variable [AI-assisted]
commits.body:
stylingConsts.borderRadius is now 'var(--gv-radius-control)' (3px in today
mode, var(--gv-radius-2) in redesign), so getTheme().borderRadius and every
styled-components reader follow the active mode.

fontFamily is NOT bridged. Its consumers only concatenate it with a fallback
stack (global-styles), which var() would tolerate, but ModeProvider reads
getTheme().fontFamily to write --gv-font-family; bridging would make the
variable refer to itself. fontFamily stays the raw tenant font.

bridge-safety.test.ts scans app/**/*.{ts,tsx} for colour functions, parse
calls, Number(), replace, string compares and arithmetic applied to bridged
keys. No offenders found; non-CSS consumers (recharts, leaflet, mapbox) do
not read borderRadius.

commits.subject: design-system(tokens): one source, generated CSS variables, typed names [AI-assisted]
commits.body:
tokens.source.json (W3C DTCG) holds every one of Tali's 187 --gv-* variables
plus 14 code-only or required semantic tokens: $value is today (styleUtils),
$extensions.gv.redesign is Tali's value (and her .gv-bo remaps for the tenant
slots and font). build-tokens.ts writes tokens.css (:root today, a
[data-gv-mode="redesign"] block re-declaring what changes and every reader),
tokens.ts (t, cssVar, TokenName, MODES) and tokens.meta.json for the scanner
and panels. --check exits 1 on drift, bad names or a broken source; normal
mode keeps the committed outputs when the source is unreadable.

The scanner skips the generated tokens.ts, which defines tokens.

commits.subject: design-system(scan): count px on style props, tolerate bad JSON, honest token scope [AI-assisted]
commits.body:
- px literals on non-spacing style props of the primitives (Box, Flex,
  Grid, Stack, Text, Title, Button, Icon, Image: width/height/w/h,
  min/max sizes, border*, borderRadius, fontSize, lineHeight,
  top/left/right/bottom) count as px; string, template and conditional
  values. Plain strings holding CSS declarations and plain-object values
  under CSS-property keys are scanned too (not style={{}} twice).
- Malformed tokens.meta.json or scan.allow.json: warn, use [], exit 0.
- Redesign-scope stand-in = on-tokens components with at least one token
  read; components with no reads keep score 1 but are not in it.
- Lazy page imports that resolve to no file are reported (warning and
  RouteMap.unresolvedImports).
